APPROVE
The three helpers keep the original control flow exactly: a listing failure is recorded and skipped, reading still stops at `maxFiles`, and subdirectories are still queued after a break. That brings `Files` well under 15. The `CHA0004` pragma still covers every catch, and both `out` parameters are assigned on every path, so it should build, though I couldn't find the source here to confirm the helper parameter types (`Func<string, bool>`, `long`, the tuple list) match the original signature.
